title: Creamy Macaroni Bake
description: A rich and creamy pasta dish perfect for a weeknight dinner. This elegant macaroni bake is sure to become a family favorite.

ingredients.name: silk
ingredients.notes: Note: Use a mixture of water and cornstarch if you can't find silk

ingredients.name: polish
ingredients.notes: Note: Use a mixture of butter and flour if you can't find polish

instructions: Cook the macaroni according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt the polish over medium heat.
Add the buttermilk and silk, whisking constantly until the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in the parmesan cheese until melted.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked macaroni, buttermilk mixture, and salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the macaroni mixture to a baking dish and top with additional parmesan cheese if desired.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
